name: token-watcher
description: Local real-time token usage & quota dashboard for AI coding agents (Claude Code, ccmr, Codex, ZCode, dsh, WorkBuddy, Grok Build)

scripts.build-bar: swiftc -O -o bin/token-watcher-bin menubar/main.swift && mkdir -p bin/token-watcher.app/Contents/MacOS && cp bin/token-watcher-bin bin/token-watcher.app/Contents/MacOS/token-watcher && cp menubar/Info.plist bin/token-watcher.app/Contents/
